policy: Only CC0, CC BY (attribution) and, for fonts, SIL Open Font License assets may enter the game. Anything NonCommercial, NoDerivatives or ShareAlike is refused, because a commercial game must be free to modify and sell its assets without copyleft or commercial limits. Editorial, 'Standard' store licences and unknown licences are refused until a human has read the terms and recorded an exception in the ledger.
